chunks: 716 - And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Whoever lights a lamp in one of the mosques of Allah, the angels and the bearers of the Throne continue to seek forgiveness for him as long as there remains light from that lamp in that mosque."

key_terms.الْمَلَائِكَةُ: the angels who seek forgiveness by Allah's permission
key_terms.حَمَلَةُ الْعَرْشِ: the bearers of the Throne, a highly exalted group of angels
key_terms.سِرَاجًا: a lamp; a source of light placed in the mosque
key_terms.ضَوْءٌ: light; the illumination that remains from the lamp
key_terms.مَسَاجِدِ اللَّهِ: the mosques belonging to Allah; sacred places of worship
key_terms.مَسْجِدٍ: a mosque; a place dedicated to worship
key_terms.يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ: they seek forgiveness; they ask Allah to forgive

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for lighting a lamp in a mosque in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the great merit of serving and maintaining the mosques of Allah. It states that even lighting a lamp in a mosque is a cause for the angels and the bearers of the Throne to seek forgiveness for the person for as long as its light remains.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.716 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:

"Whoever lights a lamp in one of the mosques of Allah (swt), the angels and the bearers of the Throne will continue to seek forgiveness for them as long as there remains any light from that lamp in the mosque."
